extraction_limitations: The source is a systematic review/meta-analysis rather than a primary experimental study; atoms describe the review itself, and individual-study findings are tagged secondary_reported_result when extracted.

The manuscript refers to a Supplementary Appendix and supplementary tables/figures, but no companion material was listed or supplied for this task; supplement-dependent details could not be independently reconciled.
The LiteratureAtom schema has no dedicated systematic_review/meta_analysis atom kind; source type is preserved via tags and statements rather than a dedicated field.

Two range-only findings were encoded with a structured midpoint solely because QuantitativeResult requires an estimate; those atoms are marked extractor_inference and tagged structured_midpoint, while the canonical statements preserve the source-reported ranges.
